safety_verdicts.content: Patient developed lower abdominal/suprapubic pain 2 days ago with a gradual onset.

safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Not documenting that the pain had a gradual onset can slightly skew clinical reasoning and differential diagnosis (e.g., sudden-onset etiologies vs evolving infection/inflammation), though other key descriptors (location, duration, worsening) are present. This is unlikely to directly cause harm but may reduce diagnostic clarity.
